# VATTAMS

> VATTAMS Home Services is a premium appliance-care platform focused on AC, washing machine and refrigerator service. Government of India MSME (Udyam) Registered Enterprise — UDYAM-TN-02-0274720.

## VATTAMS Home Services

VATTAMS Home Services provides doorstep AC, washing machine and refrigerator repair and maintenance. Customers book services through our web app or AI assistant, and we automatically assign the nearest available certified technician based on location, rating, availability, and workload.

### Services

- AC Service & Maintenance
- Washing Machine Service & Repair
- Refrigerator Service & Repair

### How It Works

1. Customer describes their problem (via chat or AI assistant)
2. Our AI system identifies the service category and urgency
3. The nearest available technician is automatically assigned
4. Technician arrives and verifies Start OTP with customer
5. Work is performed
6. End OTP verification completes the job
7. Payment is processed securely

### Key Features

- AI Booking Assistant for natural language booking
- AI Price Calculator with transparent pricing (base price, GST, platform fee, commission)
- AI Technician Assignment based on proximity, rating, and availability
- Secure OTP verification (Start & End) for every job
- Real-time chat between customers, technicians, and admin
- Wallet system for technicians with commission tracking
- CRM automation for reminders and follow-ups
- Push notifications for all booking events
- Communication Center routing all calls through VATTAMS support

### Coverage

VATTAMS Home Services has strong roots and dense coverage across Tamil Nadu (Chennai, Coimbatore, Madurai, Trichy, Salem, Erode, Tiruppur, Vellore, Hosur, Tirunelveli, Thanjavur, Dindigul, Cuddalore, and more) and is expanding service availability to additional cities across India.
